instruction: Turn on the crop/pad filter and crop 100 pixels off the top of the video.

criteria.script: async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: '.config/vlc/vlcrc', format: 'key_value', key: 'video-filter', default: '' } ] }); return data[0]; }
async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: '.config/vlc/vlcrc', format: 'key_value', key: 'croppadd-croptop', default: '0' } ] }); return data[0]; }
